scope: Bounded second pass for 2025-2026 Saudi funding, portfolio, demo-day and first-party launch signals. Only genuinely new founders with all four active gates and a C-or-better deterministic score are promoted.

scoring_policy.capacity_rule: Unknown capacity stays unknown. No record receives more than one outsourcing-likelihood point without explicit evidence of external-partner intent or a documented team audit.
scoring_policy.verification_rule: Every promoted record needs a confirmed identity, Saudi-market basis, buying authority, plausible custom-software need and at least one primary source. A/B records also need a second independent source.

evidence_catalog.paraphrase: The company identifies Gaia as a Riyadh-based sovereign enterprise-AI platform, lists an 11-50 employee band, and carries recent build and NVIDIA Inception updates.

evidence_catalog.source_title: About Gaia - Sovereign Enterprise AI from Saudi Arabia
evidence_catalog.paraphrase: Gaia describes a Saudi-hosted enterprise-AI system connecting organizational data, systems and workflows, with private early access and local data residency.
Rababah identifies himself as Gaia co-founder and CPTO and published a 2026 account of starting and building the venture with Badr Al-Malluh.
Al-Malluh identifies himself as Gaia co-founder and CEO and documents the venture's 2026 start and active product-building work.
The independent company profile corroborates Gaia's Riyadh base, enterprise-AI product and the CEO and CPTO leadership identities.
The company identifies itself as a Jubail-based Saudi AI industrial-procurement marketplace founded in 2026 and describes its RFQ-to-transaction workflow and current platform build.
Alshammari identifies himself as Smart Quotation's founder and CEO and documents active work on the Saudi industrial marketplace.

evidence_catalog.source_title: Smart Quotation onboards suppliers in Saudi Arabia
evidence_catalog.paraphrase: A current company update says the team is building the AI-powered marketplace and onboarding supplier partners across Saudi Arabia.

evidence_catalog.source_title: Radhi Alshammari on Smart Quotation and StartSmart
evidence_catalog.paraphrase: The founder describes the marketplace MVP and the venture's accelerator participation while seeking capital to advance the product.

evidence_catalog.source_title: StartSmart Saudi ninth version nominated teams
evidence_catalog.paraphrase: The official finalist roster names Radhi Alshammari for Smart Quotation and describes its AI industrial-buyer-and-supplier platform; it separately names the StethoLink team and product.

evidence_catalog.source_title: Madeed closes $925K pre-seed to scale personalised preventive healthcare in KSA
evidence_catalog.paraphrase: Wamda names Adam Bataineh as founder and CEO, dates the company only to 2025, and reports a $925,000 pre-seed round for platform product development and Saudi expansion.
Madeed presents Adam Bataineh as its founder and describes its personalized preventive-health platform.
The company page places Madeed in Riyadh, describes its health platform, shows recent Saudi launch activity and links Adam Bataineh to the company.
MABIEN identifies Dr Talal Al Baz as founder and CEO and describes the AI decision platform for medical approvals and claims.
The company page lists a 2025 founding year and Riyadh base and shows current Wadi Jeddah incubation and continued platform-building activity.
Al Baz identifies himself as MABIEN founder and CEO and reports current incubation, investment and product-development activity.

evidence_catalog.source_title: Wadi Jeddah Incubator invests SAR 1 million in 10 promising startups
evidence_catalog.paraphrase: The ecosystem report includes MABIEN and StethoLink among the 2026 Wadi Jeddah incubator selections and reports SAR 1 million of cohort investment.
The product site describes a Saudi-clinic AI assistant that captures stethoscope audio, generates clinical notes and keeps data in the Kingdom.
The company page lists a 2025 founding year, a Jeddah base and current product and program activity.
Alhashmi identifies himself as StethoLink founder and documents product work and recent StartSmart and Wadi Jeddah participation.
Governata's page lists 2024 as its founding year and describes an operating Arabic-first enterprise data-governance and AI platform.

evidence_catalog.source_title: KSA-Based Governata nets US$4 million seed round
evidence_catalog.paraphrase: Inc. Arabia reports a $4 million seed round, identifies Khalid Almudayfir as co-founder and CEO, and says the Saudi company was founded in 2024.

evidence_catalog.source_title: STAMP raises $2M to scale RegTech platform
evidence_catalog.paraphrase: Lucidity reports STAMP's $2 million pre-seed round, platform-development plans and a 2021 founding year, placing it outside the new-founder lane.
The ecosystem directory corroborates STAMP's Saudi operating basis, founders and 2021 founding year.

evidence_catalog.source_title: Aamar raises $4 million seed round to modernise Saudi rental market
evidence_catalog.paraphrase: Wamda reports Aamar's AI leasing platform, $4 million seed round and late-2023 founding, which is outside the new-founder window.
Alarfaj identifies himself as Aamar founder and CEO and documents the current Saudi proptech platform and funding milestone.
STOQA's page lists Riyadh, a 2022 founding year and an operating inventory-commerce software product.
Saud identifies himself as STOQA founder and CEO and documents the product's current operating activity.

evidence_catalog.source_title: Ventures by Startups House invests in five Attliq cohort startups
evidence_catalog.paraphrase: The program reports STOQA's cohort graduation and a $100,000 investment into each selected startup.
The marketplace listing confirms a current Android software product and a recent update, but does not make the venture a new-founder-lane company.

carryover_audit.reason: TabSense remains in holds because first-party evidence establishes substantial internal delivery capacity and its recomputed D score is not eligible for the active set. It is not reused in this wave.

gaps.detail: Madeed, MABIEN and StethoLink have strong current product triggers but only a 2025 founding year. They remain held until a primary source establishes a start date after 3 September 2025.
No promoted candidate explicitly seeks an outside software builder. Smart Quotation therefore receives only the unknown-capacity point, while Gaia receives zero plus the sufficient-capacity penalty.
Two of nine assessed prospects passed the exact new-founder lane, all four active gates and the C-or-better score rule without weakening evidence standards.
